items.title: pathlib
items.sub: Paths as objects: join, parts, checks

slides.title: Path: join and parts
slides.main: A joined path is a path again; pass it straight to open.

body.text:
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("data") / "reports" / "2024.csv"
print(p)
print(p.name, p.stem, p.suffix, p.parent)

slides.title: Checks and actions
slides.main: mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) makes the whole chain, no error if it exists.

body.text:
from pathlib import Path

folder = Path("out/logs")
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(folder / "a.txt").write_text("1", encoding="utf-8")
(folder / "b.txt").write_text("2", encoding="utf-8")
print(folder.exists(), folder.is_dir())
print(sorted(p.name for p in folder.glob("*.txt")))

slides.title: Short read and write
slides.sub: read_text, write_text; path next to script
slides.main: Path(__file__).parent is the script's folder: paths don't depend on launch.

body.text:
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("note.txt")
p.write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
print(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print(p.stat().st_size)
# next to the script: Path(__file__).parent / "data.json"

slides.title: os and shutil
slides.main: rmtree asks no confirmation, no trash: irreversible.

body.text:
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

os.environ["MODE"] = "test"
print(os.environ.get("MODE"), os.environ.get("NO_SUCH", "—"))
Path("tmp_dir").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.rmtree("tmp_dir")
print(Path("tmp_dir").exists())
Pass passwords and settings via environment variables, not in code.

slides.title: JSON
slides.sub: dumps and loads for strings, dump and load for files
slides.main: ensure_ascii=False keeps Russian letters; indent prettifies.

body.text:
import json

data = {"name": "Аня", "age": 20, "tags": ["a", "b"], "ok": True, "x": None}
text = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print(text)
print(json.loads(text) == data)

slides.title: JSON quirks
slides.sub: Keys are strings, tuples are lists

slides.title: CSV
slides.main: Open with newline='' and encoding; the module handles commas in values.

body.text:
import csv

with open("people.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["name", "age"])
    w.writerow(["Anna", 20])
    w.writerow(["Boris, jr.", 31])

with open("people.csv", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        print(row)

import csv

with open("people.csv", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
ages = [int(r["age"]) for r in rows]

slides.title: Atomic writing
slides.sub: Temp file first, then one step
slides.main: A rename happens fully or not at all: no half-broken file.

body.text:
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

def save(path, data):
    tmp = Path(str(path) + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, path)       # one indivisible operation

save("state.json", {"level": 3})
print(Path("state.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

import json

print("data" + "/" + "x.txt")      # not portable
print(Path("data") / "x.txt")
